name: Gasthof Neuhaus
beschreibung:
Peacefully located in the town of Kufstein, the traditional Gasthof Neuhaus offers comfortable guestrooms and down-to-earth Tyrolean cooking. It makes a versatile base for culture and active holidays.

The historic Old Town, Kufstein Fortress, and the Inn cycle path are easily reached on foot.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Neuhaus in Kufstein provides traditional hospitality near the river Inn and the historic fortress.
